scientific_integrity: All-dimensional claims are supported by the exact spectral and determinant proof, not by finite numerical experiments. Classical sine eigenvectors, sine-product identities, Vandermonde determinants and the Cauchy determinant are acknowledged mathematical prior work. Priority beyond inspected references is not certified.
scientific_limitations: Uniform symmetric nearest-neighbor Toeplitz path, a single unit coordinate observation, horizons H >= n, and determinant criterion only. Infinite horizons require strict Schur stability. General path Laplacians, heterogeneous couplings, multisensor design and other Gramian objectives are excluded.
title: Coprime placement invariance of the path observability determinant
